purpose: Local engineering acceptance plus indexed independent component demonstrations; partial D8 preparation only
default_steps: D and shared core/policy unit tests
D2 fixed candidate templates and controls
D3a frozen rules and mock parser faults
optional_cached_step: --with-cached-models adds existing D3b cache verification and D7 component ablation, without new requests
defaults: Fresh output only, fixed inputs, no auto install/retry, fail on child failure/timeout, nonempty unit groups with zero fail/error/skip, validate observations in addition to child exit, freeze inputs and verify unchanged
demonstrations: review unregistered push rejected in IR
indirect injection detection and A DENY
review A CONFIRM with no execution
expired memory denial and local audit parent chain
negative_results: Preserve original D3a FP=6/FN=3, D2 unsupported=20, D7 representation misses and earlier integration defects. Engineering PASS is not a security-quality threshold or whole-system acceptance.
not_run: C approval/execution or OS sandbox acceptance
fresh model inference or paid API
constraints: Separate child runs reuse original D scripts unmodified; output is indexed component evidence, not stitched execution causality. Network hooks are process checks, not OS containment. Prerequisites must already be locally installed. Git is used read-only by existing runners. SQLite and parser fault subprocesses are local.
